#AVAX Market Analysis

AVAX is at 10.042 on the 4h, bouncing after a wick toward 9.35 found buyers right at the descending support trendline from late September. Price is now pushing back toward the 10.20 level, which capped the last bounce.

Bull case: reclaim 10.20 and push back into the range, opening a path toward 10.60 and the 11.00 zone.
Bear case: reject here and lose the trendline near 9.50, exposing 9.00 and the 8.60 breakout zone from September.

Trendline bounce turns into a range reclaim, or does support finally crack?

Bitcoin Tests $80.4K Support as October Lags History

“The line in the sand is the support trendline currently near $80.4K.” – Read More

By Andrew Kamsky | @cryptoquant_official

$BTC sellers capitulated again yesterday.

Every burst of loss selling came right at a local bottom: early August, mid-August and mid-September.

Profit taking has slowed since the September high.

If the pattern holds, yesterday's selling just above $80k would mark the floor.

#TRX Market Analysis

TRX is at 0.3347 on the 8h, bouncing hard after a clean tap of the rising trendline from the June lows near 0.3270. Price is coiling inside a large symmetrical triangle, with the descending trendline from the May highs capping the top near 0.3480.

Bull case: clear 0.3360 and push toward 0.3400, opening a path to the 0.3480 triangle resistance.
Bear case: reject here and fade below 0.3320, exposing another test of the rising trendline near 0.3280.

Triangle support sparks the next leg up, or one more retest first?
